# Valtraq Healthcare

> Valtraq Healthcare is an Indian clinical intelligence company that delivers
> clinical decision support as a service. Its platform, Valtraq CDSS, gives
> outpatient physicians guideline-grounded decision support inside the
> consultation, with every output reviewed by the treating physician.

## What Valtraq does

Valtraq provides "intelligence as a service" for clinical care. Rather than
selling software for providers to operate themselves, Valtraq delivers decision
support, clinical guideline curation, clinical analytics, and integration as one
managed service. Its initial clinical focus is outpatient diabetes and
cardiometabolic care in India.

## Valtraq CDSS

Valtraq CDSS is a clinical decision support system for outpatient care. It
surfaces guideline-grounded considerations, safety flags, and structured
documentation during a consultation. It does not act autonomously: the treating
physician accepts, modifies, or discards every output before it reaches a
patient. Reasoning is constrained to established diabetes frameworks — RSSDI,
ADA, EASD, and IDF — applied in a fixed priority order.

## Important qualifications

- Valtraq CDSS is clinical decision support for qualified physicians. It does
  not provide medical advice and is not a substitute for clinical judgment.
- Citation of clinical guidelines does not imply endorsement by those bodies or
  regulatory approval of Valtraq CDSS.
- Figures shown in the clinic economics model on the website are an illustrative
  scenario built on published independent ambulatory-AI benchmarks. They are not
  measured Valtraq deployment results.
